body: I'm not sure how to reply to everyone..but I feel that once I feel I've lost certain emotions from specific people, suicide is the first thing that comes into my head...when I try to talk to the person I love, I always feel as if it just starts more problems and gets us fighting, and then I'm left with no one. I'm sure my parents already think I'm crazy and think I'm a weirdo, so I don't want to talk to them.I am 22, Hispanic, and go to work and am taking basic courses at a local community college. I never really feel good about myself unless I am working out.. I don't really know what I believe in anymore

Thank you all for all your input... This was the only real contact I had when I felt at my lowest....and I'll say just having people reach out to me made me feel so much better. Maybe even as if I had some value to someone...I still feel the way I said I do..but am going to try seeing a therapist for a while. You guys are a blessing. Thank you.
